client_only_extensions.note: Local completed/partial results, private failures, pure projection and caller validator. No invented DTO fields or annotations.

dart_policies: Raw/typed result Futures cache both success and failure; arbitrary parsed T remains application/parser-owned.
Single-use Stream break closes local observation; controlled nextEvent continues into same finalResult cursor.
Retained messages default1024 and encoded turn/actions/messages total4MiB; overflow is local typed failure.
First completed item ID wins (Node policy; Python may overwrite same ID); stable output_index sorting.

Item containing turn is authoritative, so forwarded child items are excluded before root identity checks. Matching root/session/envelope identities required for safe completed result/artifact routing.
One event-loop grace plus snapshot queue count permits alreadybuffered manual-action clearing; ongoing unrelated noise cannot reset grace.
Synchronous caller validator mustvalidateeverytextblock; creation binds canonical agent.text.format, followup never changes serverformat.
